description:
FILED s473t5f (#1501 round 7, uni/, 2026-09-13).  PRE-EXISTING; ASCII-probed,
so it is NOT the #418 non-ASCII-label family the round's brief guessed.

A loop-control keyword aimed at a label that does not exist leaks SBCL's
internal control error where perl raises its own diagnostic:

    no warnings;
    eval "last FOO"; print $@;

    perl: Label not found for "last FOO" at (eval 1) line 1.
    PCL : attempt to THROW to a tag that does not exist: pcl::LAST-foo
          at (eval 1) line 1.

`next` and `redo` are identical.  The BEHAVIOUR is right (it dies, it does not
fall through) and the death IS trappable by `eval`, so this is the "exact
fatal-error TEXT is not a goal unless cheap" class -- except that a HOST error
is leaking into a Perl-level place, which `docs/not-supported.md`'s own
uni/goto.t registration already flags as a QUALITY NIT of the same shape
("SBCL's 'The function common-lisp:nil is undefined' -- an internal error
leaking where a Perl-level one belongs, CLAUDE.md 12 in spirit").

AND IT IS CHEAP, which is why it is filed rather than written off: `p-last` /
`p-next` / `p-redo` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~13588) expand to
`(throw ',(%pcl-loop-tag "LAST" label) nil)`.  A `throw` to a missing tag
signals a CONTROL-ERROR *before* transferring control, so a `handler-case`
around it is entered ONLY on the error and costs nothing on the taken path:

    (handler-case (throw TAG nil)
      (control-error () (p-die "Label not found for \"last NAME\" ...")))

The labelled form is the only one affected -- the unlabelled `last`/`next`
are `(return nil)` / `(go :next)` and cannot miss.  `p-last-dynamic` (the
cross-function spelling test.pl's `skip` uses) is the same throw and wants the
same wrapper.

WHAT IT COSTS: `t/uni/labels.t` rows 4, 5, 6 (the file's own
"last/redo/next's error is UTF-8 clean" trio).  `t/op/runlevel.t` asserts the
same message and is in the #1652 `run_multiple_progs` blocked set, so it adds
nothing measurable until that clears.  `lib/warnings/pp_ctl` has it too.
subject: last/next/redo to a NON-EXISTENT label leaks SBCL "attempt to THROW to a tag that does not exist" where perl says Label not found for "last FOO" -- cheap: a handler-case round the throw; t/uni/labels.t rows 4-6
